purpose: Contract shape for a read-only MCP Locker discovery probe; not a captured Locker response.

probe.requestLogPolicy: Metadata only: endpoint class, tool name, outcome, duration, retry count and schema fingerprint. Never log request/response bodies, headers, tokens, source excerpts or prompts.

tools.name: pull_requests.list
tools.description: SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE ONLY: lists pull requests with cursor pagination.

items.body: Not retained by the proposed adapter.

expectedAdapterBehavior.cursorRule: Persist the cursor or watermark only in the same committed transaction as normalized records. Do not advance it on malformed data, timeout, permission denial, cancellation or partial page processing.
expectedAdapterBehavior.retryRule: Retry only transient network/429/5xx outcomes with a bounded exponential backoff and Retry-After when supplied. Never retry authorization failures, schema violations or write-capable tools.
expectedAdapterBehavior.schemaRule: Reject unknown required fields, tool-name drift, pagination-shape drift and result objects that exceed the approved schema until reviewed.
